articles.summary: Veteran retail operating executive brings deep expertise in multi-unit operations, talent development, real estate and supply chain CAVA Group, Inc. (NYSE: CAVA), the category-defining Mediterranean fast-casual restaurant brand that brings heart, health, and humanity to food, today announced the appointment of Amiee Bayer-Thomas, Chief Retail Officer of Ulta Beauty, Inc., to its Board of Directors, effective today, July 29. Her experience leading complex national operations, developing talent and scaling for growth will be invaluable as CAVA continues expanding.
